name: types all kinds
source:
import * as stylex from '@stylexjs/stylex';
export const vars = stylex.defineVars({
  t1: stylex.types.angle('45deg'),
  t2: stylex.types.color('red'),
  t3: stylex.types.url('url(a.png)'),
  t4: stylex.types.image('url(b.png)'),
  t5: stylex.types.integer(5),
  t6: stylex.types.lengthPercentage(5),
  t7: stylex.types.length(5),
  t8: stylex.types.percentage(0.07),
  t9: stylex.types.number(1.5),
  t10: stylex.types.resolution('2dppx'),
  t11: stylex.types.time(0),
  t12: stylex.types.transformFunction('scale(1)'),
  t13: stylex.types.transformList('scale(1) rotate(45deg)'),
});

expectedRules.ltr: @property --x1nlt3jb { syntax: "<transform-list>"; inherits: true; initial-value: scale(1) rotate(45deg) }
